engineCapabilities.title: Five-engine capability overview
engineCapabilities.description: Codex, Claude, Grok, OpenCode, and the built-in Agent all support start, stop, restart, and resume. MCP is executed only by Codex and the built-in Agent; Claude / Grok / OpenCode do not consume in-app MCP config. Restart means stopping the current run and starting again, not resuming an old CLI session. Built-in Agent free sessions support mid-session follow-ups.

notes.codex: Supports start/stop/resume/mid-session input (SDK channel keeps stdin; send_codex_input while running). Restart = stop current run then start again (not CLI resume of an old session). CLI batch channel has no stdin; send returns an explicit error. Session launch injects app MCP.
notes.claude: Supports start/stop/resume/mid-session input (SDK bridge keeps stdin). Restart = stop current run then start again (not CLI resume of an old session). CLI batch channel does not support mid-session input. Local CLI/SDK can attach images; SSH skips images. Does not execute in-app MCP config.
notes.opencode: Supports start/stop/resume/mid-session input (SDK bridge keeps stdin; append prompts on the same OpenCode session). Restart = stop current run then start again (not CLI resume of an old session). Does not execute in-app MCP config.
notes.grok: Supports start/stop/resume. Restart = stop current run then start again (not CLI resume of an old session). Grok is a headless CLI (-p + Stdio::null) with no writable mid-session stdin (B1 exemption). Does not execute in-app MCP config.
notes.native: Supports start/stop/resume/mid-session input (in-process follow-ups). Restart = stop current run then start again. Task sessions exit after one turn; free sessions accept follow-up input. Injects bound MCP tools: local spawn on this machine, SSH spawn on the remote host.
